name: UF-style-solo
note: solo — exactly one centered subject on a plain background. PICO-8, 96x96 transparent. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-solo.  (sample: seed 1479)

form.subject: a (wooden treasure chest:1.3) (overflowing with gold coins:1.2) and jewels
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (wooden treasure chest:1.3) (overflowing with gold coins:1.2) and jewels' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped' --style solo --out 96x96 --palette PICO-8 --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --transparent --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1479
